entry.text: In January 2023 the book was permanently banned from libraries and classrooms in St. Johns County School District, and in September 2023 it was banned from libraries and classrooms in Matanuska-Susitna Borough School District.

entry.text: In 1985 a group of Islamists won an injunction removing the book from the market in Egypt, and a year later a higher court reversed the decision.

sources.title: The Arabian Nights: Obscene Pornography or a Great Work of Culture? (Qantara, Samir Grees)
sources.quote: It's not the first time that The Arabian Nights have led to angry debate in Egypt. In 1985, a group of Islamists managed to win an injunction removing the book from the market. A year later, a higher court reversed the decision.

entry.note: Matches our Egypt 1985-86 rescinded row. Casanova Society NZ restriction on Wikipedia's NZ list has no year in the table text, so not used.

entry.text: The novel was placed on the Index in 1834.

sources.title: Notre-Dame de Paris (roman) - Wikipédia
sources.quote: Considéré comme une lecture pernicieuse par l'Église catholique, Notre-Dame de Paris fait partie des romans mis à l' Index en 1834

entry.note: French Wikipedia states the 1834 Index listing; footnote text not recovered. Quote contains 'l' Index' with a space from the wikilink rendering. English Wikipedia's Index list says 'Until 1959' for Hugo's Notre Dame de Paris, which conflicts with our row end year 1966 (Index discontinued 1966; 1959 unsourced there).

row_issues.issue: End year 1966 vs en.wikipedia Index list 'Until 1959' for Notre Dame de Paris; start 1834 confirmed by fr.wikipedia. Needs a primary check if end year is shown.
